comparison.method: Crop the game viewport to 16:9, scale to 160x90 grayscale, and compare against Franchise_Ident.bik decoded at 10 fps using normalized Pearson correlation.
comparison.interpretation: The fullscreen phone content reached the end of Franchise_Ident.bik and wrapped to its beginning during the interval; both captures match the original retail file at greater than 0.998 correlation. The startup screen remained on this video content across the sample rather than showing a language/menu transition.

limits: The source-time matches are quantized to 0.1 seconds and do not count every presented frame.
The capture proves the observed screen is looping retail video; it does not prove whether the intended game flow requires input or identify the guest/runtime reason for remaining on the video.
